title: Greek Lamb Kebabs
description: Quick and flavorful Greek lamb kebabs, perfect for a summer evening. Marinate the lamb in a mix of olive oil, lemon juice, and herbs before grilling to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot with a side of pita bread, lemon wedges, and a sprinkle of parsley.
